machine: MacBook Air M2, macOS 27.2.1 (26B131), 2x, SDR; Dark, NSGlassTintAmount 0.507

inner_refraction.formula: src = p + n*A*m(depth,H), A<0 samples inward

real_active_recipes_fit.note: colour terms off, refraction inputs untouched (rg-dark)

outer_refraction.formula: c = mix(c_inner, sample(p + n*Ao*m(depth,Ho)), opacity*saturate((d - d0)/(d1 - d0))), d=-depth, recipes d0=-1 d1=0
outer_refraction.isolated_fit: pixel exact (<=1 px) over a 10 pt band and in the 1 pt recipe band (-48,-15 px predicted and measured)

recipes_active_dark.D: min(width,height) of the glass shape, points

dark_specular.formula: c' = c*(1 + bias*hl*(3-2c)); hl = sum over +-dir of schlick(lobe*mask, amount); schlick(v,a)=v/((1/a-2)(1-v)+1); lobe=saturate((cos t - cos s)/(1-cos s))
dark_specular.dir: (sin angle, -cos angle), angle pi/2 -> left and right edges
dark_specular.mask: 1 px (0.5 pt) line just outside the edge (offset -0.5, height 0.5)

key_fill_highlight.formula: dst' = dst + m*(M*dst + b - dst), m = schlick(spec,0.5)+schlick(diffuse,0.075) per lobe

chromatic_aberration.regular_clear_dock_cc_nc: none: |R-B| <= 2 levels over 6 px black/white stripes and 8 px checker, whole glass incl. rim
chromatic_aberration.spotlight_field: none over 6 px stripes (only the coloured caret)
chromatic_aberration.switch_knob_held: rim only; interior R=G=B source positions

light_direction.window_position: bit identical at (40,60) and (640,700): 0 px differ by >1 level
light_direction.pointer_over_plain_glass: bit identical (max diff 0) at rim top, centre, rim left, dock-variant glass

glass_button.press: grows ~1.5 pt per side, soft glow centred on the pointer, gaussian sigma ~26 pt on a 140x32 button, peak ~+12 levels, follows drag

switch_knob_held.fit: 7.75*m(depth,31) - 4.65*m(depth,3.1): rms 0.26 pt (free fit A1 7.75 H1 31.8, rms 0.15 pt)
switch_knob_held.magnification: about 0.79x across the lens (source = r + disp, d disp/dr ~ +0.27)

slider_knob_held.measured: interior ramp slope 0.70 with an offset; not explained by the stack
